DIGITAL MARKETING AGREEMENT 
 
 This Digital Marketing Agreement (“ Agreement ”) is made at Karachi on the [●] day of [●] , [●] 
 
 BY AND BETWEEN 
 
 
 ZAMEEN MEDIA (PRIVATE) LIMITED , a company incorporated under the laws of Pakistan, with its registered office at 3 rd floor, Pearl One, 94-B/I, M.M. Alam Road, Gulberg III, Lahore, acting through its CEO/ duly authorized representative Zeeshan Ali Khan (hereinafter referred to as the “ Zameen”, which expression shall mean and include, where the context so permits, its successors-in-interest and permitted assigns), of the FIRST PART; 
 
 AND 
 
 FAYSAL BANK LIMITED , a company incorporated under the laws of Pakistan, having its registered office at Faysal House, ST-02, Shahrah-e-Faisal, Karachi , acting through its duly authorized representative Mr. Talha Hameed hereinafter referred to as the “ Bank ”, which expression shall mean and include, where the context so permits, it’s successors-in-interest and permitted assigns), of the OTHER PART . 
 
 Zameen and the Bank , shall be referred to individually as “ Party ” and collectively as “ Parties ”. 
 
 
 
 WHEREAS 
 
 Zameen is in the business of providing digital marketing solutions and o nline m arketplace s ervices , including inter alia adverti sing, marketing and IT-enabled s ervices, as well as an online marketplace providing related services; 
 
 The Bank is a financial institution offering various services to its customers ; and 
 
 The Bank is desirous of engaging Zameen’s Online Marketplace Services and Zameen is desirous of providing such services in accordance with the terms and conditions of this Agreement. 
 
 NOW, THEREFORE , the Parties agree as follows : 
 
 DEFINITIONS 
 
 Confidential Information means such information as either party may from time to time provide to the another party, in whatever form including without limitation in writing or orally, electronically or through physical documentation including but not limited to reports, leads, interpretations, forecasts, analyses, compilations, memoranda, concepts, designs, site maps, site surveys, location/site images and videos, feasibility reports, financial data and projections, and/or any other relating data, and all know-how, trade secrets, tactical, strategical, statistical, financial, commercial or technical information of any kind, directly or indirectly disclosed, before or after the signing of the Agreement by or on behalf of one Party to another Party or any of its authorised recipients, which contain or otherwise reflect in whole or in part any of the Confidential Information, whether in existence at the date of signing of this Agreement or which subsequently comes into existence including any copies, reproductions, duplicates or notes in any form whatsoever. 
 
 Intellectual Property includes, but is not limited to, any inventions, technological innovations, discoveries, designs, formulas, know-how, processes, business methods, patents, trademarks, service marks, copyrights, computer software, ideas, creations, writings, lectures, illustrations, photographs, motion pictures, scientific and mathematical models, improvements to all such property, and all recorded material defining, describing, or illustrating all such property, whether in hard copy or electronic form. 
 
 Online Marketplace means www.zameen.com &amp; www.olx.com.pk or other website (s) owned, operated and maintained by or on behalf of Zameen. 
 
 Online Marketplace Services means all services to be provided by Zameen during the Term of this Agreement, including advertising services, IT and IT-enabled services, and the online marketplace services, as more specifically described in Annexure A. 
 
 Marketing Material means artwork, photographs, data, product information, branding, advertising, marketing or promotional material or any such information and/or materials related to the Bank and the various financial facilities and services offered by the Bank . 
 
 Mature Lead means a Qualified Lead approved by the Bank for a loan and its disbursal ; 
 
 Qualified Lead has the meaning assigned to it in Clause 3 . 1(b) ; 
 
 Service s Fee means the sum total of the Online Marketplace Services and the Loan Disbursement Fee due and payable to Zameen by the Bank , as stipulated in Clause 5.1 under this Agreement. 
 
 Term has the meaning assigned to it in Clause 2. 1 . 
 
 TERM &amp; SCOPE 
 
 This Agreement shall be effective for a period of one (1) year , from [ ● ] to [ ● ] unless extended in accordance with Clause 2.4 below (the “ Term ”) . 
 
 The Bank hereby agrees to avail the Online Marketplace Services from Zameen and Zameen agrees to provide such services to the Bank during the Term in accordance with the terms and conditions of this Agreement. 
 
 This Agreement, along with all a nnexure s attached hereto and the terms of use of the Online Marketplace available at https://www.zameen.com/terms.html and https://help.olx.com.pk/hc/en-us/categories/360000044302-Legal-Privacy-information , shall constitute the complete and exclusive agreement between the Parties, and shall supersede and replace any prior written or oral understanding or communication between the Parties. 
 
 This Agreement shall not be amended , modified or revised except through the written consent of both Parties. 
 
 TERMS OF SERVICES 
 
 Zameen shall , subject to the Bank fulfilling its obligations under Clause 7 below, perform the Online Marketplace Services and online lead generation services as more fully described in Annexure A and Annexure B (“ Services ”) respectively , which inter alia include : 
 
 Setting up, placing, and publishing advertisements for product promotion for the Bank on the Online Marketplace ; 
 
 Generation of leads as per the criteria in Annexure B of this Agreement wherein the information of every lead shall be verified/screened by Zameen (“ Qualified Lead ”) and provided to the Bank for approval and grant of loan ; and 
 
 Provision of monthly reports to the Bank of all Services delivered and performed, as more fully detailed in Annexure A and Annexure B . 
 
 Zameen shall obtain the written approval of the Bank with respect to any layout, design, style or any other visual element with respect to the Marketing Material prior to the publication thereof in connection with the performance of the Online Marketplace Services. Provided that if no response is received from the Bank within three ( 3 ) working days of submission for approval by Zameen, the material or advertisement shall be deemed approved . 
 
 Zameen reserves the right, to decline to publish or to omit, suspend or change the placement of any Marketing Material from the Online Marketplace in the event that Zameen determines, at its sole discretion, that the Marketing Material breaches any applicable laws, infringes the rights of any third party (including inter alia I ntellectual P roperty rights), is prejudicial or detrimental to the interest of Zameen and/ or its business. 
 
 Zameen reserves the right to change, modify or alter the Online Marketplace design, structure, and layout without any written consent or notice to the Bank. 
 
 NOTICE OF MODIFICATIONS 
 
 In the event that the Bank desires any modifications/amendments to the Marketing Material of the Bank ’s financial products on the Online Marketplace, the Bank shall submit a written request to Zameen by emailing at muhammad.hasan@zameen.com in relation thereto at least seven (7) working days prior to the date on which the Bank desires the change to be affected. Zameen will endeavor to incorporate the modifications requested without unreasonable delay. For the avoidance of doubt, the number of requests for modification and/ or amendment in the Marketing Material under this Clause 4 .1 shall only be entertained by Zameen twice during the Term of this Agreement. 
 
 SERVICE FEE 
 
 As consideration for the performance of Online Marketplace Services, Zameen shall be entitled to, and the Bank shall be liable to pay to Zameen, 
 
 a sum of Rs. 4,200,000 (Rupees four million two hundred thousand ) exclusive of tax (the “ Online Marketplace Fee ”) during the Term of this Agreement in accordance with Clause 5.2 below ; and 
 
 pay loan disbursement fee for conversion of leads by the Bank in the manner prescribed in Clause 5,3 (the “ Loan Disbursement Fee ”) . 
 
 The Online Marketplace Fee and the Loan Disbursement Fee shall hereinafter be referred to as the “ Service s Fee ” , attached hereto a s Annexure C . 
 
 The Bank shall pay to Zameen in clear funds , the Online Marketplace Fee in six (6) equal instalments in the following manner: 
 
 first instalment amounting to a sum equal of Rs. 350,000 (Rupees three hundred and fifty thousand ) shall be paid in advance at the time of signing of this Agreement to Zameen vide cheque no. [ ● ] dated [ ● ] (the “ Advance Instalment ”) , r eceipt of which is hereby duly acknowledged by the Bank , and a copy of the aforementioned cheque is attached hereto as Annexure D ; 
 
 second instalment amounting to a sum equal of Rs. 350,000 (Rupees three hundred and fifty thousand ) shall be paid in advance on or before [ ● ] (the “ Second Instalment ”) to Zameen ; 
 
 third instalment amounting to a sum equal of Rs. 350,000 (Rupees three hundred and fifty thousand ) shall be paid in advance on or before [ ● ] (the “ Third Instalment ”) to Zameen ; 
 
 fourth instalment amounting to a sum equal of Rs. 350,000 (Rupees three hundred and fifty thousand ) shall be paid in advance on or before [ ● ] (the “ Fourth Instalment ”) to Zameen ; 
 
 f ifth instalment amounting to a sum equal of Rs.350,000 (Rupees three hundred and fifty thousand) shall be paid in advance on or before [ ● ] (the “ F ifth Instalment ”) to Zameen; and 
 
 sixth instalment amounting to a sum equal of Rs.350,000 (Rupees three hundred and fifty thousand) shall be paid in advance on or before [ ● ] (the “ F inal Instalment ”) to Zameen . 
 
 For the avoidance of doubt, the Advance Instalment, Second Instalment, Third Instalment, Fourth Instalment, Fifth Instalment and Final Instalment shall together constitute as the total Online Marketplace Fee due to be paid by the Customer to Zameen in accordance with this Clause 5.2, under this Agreement . 
 
 The Bank shall be liable to pay to Zameen in clear funds zero point five percent (0.5%) of the loan amount as Loan Disbursement Fee, with respect to e very Mature Lead within one (1) month from date of disbursal of such loan amount. 
 
 Zameen shall invoice the Bank for Service s Fee from time to time in accordance with the terms of this Agreement and the annexures hereto. 
 
 The Bank shall clear every payment no later than five (5) w orking d ays from the date of applicable invoice. Any delay in payment may result in suspension of Services, until such time as all outstanding payments or invoices are cleared. 
 
 Any delay in payment may result in suspension of Online Marketplace Services, until such time as all outstanding payment(s) or invoice(s) are cleared. 
 
 Notwithstanding anything in the Agreement, the Service s Fee is non- refundable and non - adjustable. 
 
 Service s Fee shall be subject to deduction of any and all applicable taxes in accordance with law. 
 
 RESPONSIBILITIES AND OBLIGATIONS 
 
 The Bank shall: 
 
 assist, cooperate with and facilitate Zameen as and when required for perform ance of Online Marketplace Services hereunder; 
 
 provide any and all Marketing Material, including any modifications or amendments thereto, necessary for the performance of Online Marketplace Services , during the Term. The Bank acknowledges that a ny delay by the Bank under this Clause 6.1 may result in a delay in delivery of the Online Marketplace Services for which Zameen shall not be responsible. 
 
 m ake timely payments of Service s Fee due to Zameen as and when due under this Agreement . 
 
 notify Zameen of any changes to its procedures affecting the performance of Online Marketplace Services under this Agreement at least 15 (fifteen) days prior to implementation of such changes . 
 
 p rovide contact details to Zameen of the Bank’s designated personnel authorized as points of contact to receive Qualified L ead ( s ) from Zameen under this Agreement , the same shall be updated in writing to Zameen if any change occurred. Bank shall ensure that such contact details are routinely updated and accordingly conveyed to Zameen in writing in case of any change therein. 
 
 i mplement standard operating procedures for lead conversion, including inter alia the Bank’s designated representative calling the Qualified L ead (s) and initiating the login process, to be strictly followed by the Bank upon receipt of leads generated through performance of digital Services by Zameen. 
 
 e nsure that in order to obtain the B ank ’s loan facility, the Qualified L ead s’ loan application is processed by the Bank, in a timely manner. The decision to approve or refuse a loan, or to login or reject a case even prior to the login rests entirely with the Bank. 
 
 e nsure that Zameen receives a fortnightly report of the Mature Leads as well as all other leads, regardless of the source, whose loan applications have been approved and disbursed by the Bank. 
 
 The Bank confirms that it shall at all times be the sole responsibility of the Bank to ensure the accuracy of any and all Marketing Material published and transmitted in connection with this Agreement and performance of obligations hereunder. 
 
 Zameen shall: 
 
 e nsure that Online Marketplace Services are performed in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement . 
 
 e nsure that leads are qualified in accordance with Annexure B of this Agreement . 
 
 e nsure that Q ualified L eads are forwarded to the designated/authorized personnel of the Bank in a timely manner . 
 
 offer discounted services to any leads shared by the Bank under Clause 6.1(h).

 TERMINATION 
 
 Either Party may terminate this Agreement at any time , by giving [ ● ] days’ notice in writing to the other Party. 
 
 Notwithstanding the foregoing, i n the event of a breach of obligation, representation or warranty, either Party may give [ ● ] days’ notice in writing to the other Party to remedy such breach of obligation, representation or warranty within seven (7) days from the date of notice . In case of failure of the other Party to remedy such breach within seven (7) days from the date of such notice, the Party shall be entitle d to terminate this Agreement forthwith. 
 
 The Bank shall clear all outstanding invoices within seven (7) days of the expiry or termination of this Agreement . 
 
 LIABILITY 
 
 Zameen shall not be responsible or liable for any loss (es) , damage (s) or claim(s) , including without limitation, arising from or in connection with any of the products, financial facilities , the Marketing Material and /or services offered by the Bank . 
 
 The Bank shall not be liable for any misrepresentation, mistake and/or negligence on the part of Zameen, its directors, officers and employees. Irrespective of the number or basis of the claim(s), in relation thereto, Zameen’s maximum aggregate liability to the Bank, under this Agreement, in respect of any direct loss (or any other loss), whether such claim(s) arises in contract or in tort, shall not exceed a sum equal in value to the amount already paid to Zameen in terms of Online Marketplace Fee by the Bank in relation to which such claim arises . 
 
 INDEMNITY 
 
 The Bank shall indemnify and hold harmless Zameen, its executives, officers, directors, members, managers, employees, agents and representatives from and against any claims arising from acts or omissions, gross negligence or wilful misconduct of the Bank and/or its products with respect to which the Online Marketplace Services are to be performed , breach of any of its obligations, agreements, or duties under this Agreement, or for any other reason whatsoever, and Zameen shall not be liable to pay any penalty that may be imposed in respect thereof or bear any costs in association with aforesaid act or omission of the Bank . 
 
 CONFIDENTIALITY 
 
 Both Parties hereby undertake and agree that they shall, at all times, keep the other Party’s Confidential Information confidential, including the contents of this Agreement, except as and to the extent necessary to disclose under compulsion of law.

 The Bank hereby permits Zameen to use publish and reproduce the Bank’s name, logo, trademarks and brands to the extent necessary for the performance of the Online Marketplace Services . 
 
 Each Party further acknowledges that the trademarks, brand names, trade names, trade dress, copyright and/or any other I ntellectual P roperty of the other Party shall remain the exclusive property of that Party and agree not to challenge the proprietary rights of such Party therein or their registration now
